grounding.states: The Oakville, Ontario Costco is not open yet and is slated to open in 2027
grounding.from: FlamboroughToday headline says the opening is slated for 2027; construction firm's project page says anticipated to open later in 2027

grounding.states: Closest open warehouse found: Burlington, 1225 Brant St
grounding.from: Several listings give this address (1225 Brant St, Burlington, ON L7P 1X7)

grounding.states: A Laird Rd warehouse in Mississauga, 3180 Laird Rd, is said to serve Oakville, though not from Costco
grounding.from: One third-party deals site (yepsavings.com) says the Laird Rd warehouse serves Mississauga and Oakville; gives the address as 3180 Laird Rd; not an official Costco source

grounding.states: No driving distances or times were found, so which is closer cannot be said
grounding.from: The results gave no driving distances or times from Oakville to either warehouse

value.answer: The Oakville Costco isn't open yet. It's slated to open in 2027. The closest open one I found is the Burlington warehouse at 1225 Brant St, (905) 336-6714. A deals site also lists a Laird Rd warehouse in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd as serving Oakville, but that isn't from Costco itself. I couldn't find drive times to either, so I can't say which is closer.
